newsitem.title: USA: WebSecure says restating Q1 revenue.
newsitem.headline: WebSecure says restating Q1 revenue.

text.p: WebSecure Inc said Friday it was restating its revenues for the first quarter ended November 30, 1996 after an investigation found it had misstated its figures.
The company said it had believed it had purchased licensing software during the first quarter in exchange for stock from Manadarin Trading Co Ltd, an Irish corporation.
The company said about $792,000 of its previously reported first quarter sales of about $887,000 were for that software.

But the company said the investigation found it had never received any software from Manadarin, and even though it received approximately $792,000 from two purported sublicenses of the software, WebSecure never delivered any software to them.
The company said it would book the money received from the sublicensees as cash, instead of revenue, and simultaneously record the $792,000 as a liability on its books.
The company said its investigation was conducted during the last two months, at its request, by the Boston law firm of Hill & Barlow.
The company said it considering further action and plans to report its findings to the proper authorities and cooperate with any further investigation.
